title: Phase 2 study evaluating the efficacy of injectable gentamicin in hereditary ichthyosis - GENTIC
official: Phase 2 study evaluating the efficacy of injectable gentamicin in hereditary ichthyosis - GENTIC
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of gentamicin on the severity of scales and erythema, at M3 versus baseline in moderate to severe congenital ichthyosis caused by a nonsense mutation

interventions.name: Gentamicin Panpharma 40 mg/ml solution for injection/infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult patients (≥18 years) affiliated to a social insurance protection regimen
2. Hereditiary ichthyosis caused by a homozygous non-sense mutation of a gene responsible for hereditiary ichthyosis (TGM1, PNPLA1, ALOX12B, NIPAL4, ALOXE3, SDR9C7, ABCA12, CERS3, SPINK5 and CDSN)
3. Moderate to severe forms of ichthyosis defined as VIIS score at 2-3 on at least 2 out of 4 areas evaluated (back, upper limbs, lower limbs, back of the foot)
4. Free, informed consent, written and signed by the participant and the investigator (at the latest on the day of inclusion and before any examination required by the research).
Exclusion criteria:
1. Cutaneous signs suggesting a surinfection
2. Patient under guardianship, curatorship or deprived of their liberty
3. Variation greater than 15% in the VIIS score between two baseline measurements at the end of the "run-in"period
4. Hypersensibility of active substance or one of the gentamicin excipients
5. Administration of an aminoside in the previous 3 months
6. Treatment with nephrotoxic or ototoxic medication in the previous 6 weeks
7. Pregnant or breastfeeding women, or women planning to become pregnant or breastfeed during the study. Women of childbearing age, potentially sexually active, and unwilling to use acceptable contraceptive measures in accordance with CTFG recommandations
8. Subjects >75 years (physiological impairment of kidney function)
9. Left ventricular insufficiency
10. Hypoalbuminemia
11. Myasthenia
12. History of necrosis at the injection site during previous treatment with aminosid
13. Patient with pre-existing neuromuscular disease
14. Patient participating in another clinical study with an investigational treatment
15. Grade B or C cirrhosis according to Child-Pugh classification
16. Nephropathy or other situation at risk of renal dysfunction
17. Renal insufficiency with GFR < 60mL/min
18. Surdity which is not caused by plug scales in the external ear canals or other situation at risk of surdity including the presence of the A1555G mutation in the 12S rRNA (mitochondrial DNA) gene
19. Patient who modify his keratolytic or emollient treatment in the last two weeks previous the inclusion visit
20. Patient who modify his retinoid topic treatment in the month previous the inclusion visit
21. Patient who modify his systemic retinoid treatment in the 3 months previous the inclusion visit
